C_COD_NAMES_THE_MISCOMPUTATION.rationale: The candidate clearly explains the exact miscomputation (calculating the discount amount rather than the discounted price, charging $20 instead of $80), which well exceeds level 3's vague identification, but it stops short of level 5 by not explicitly identifying who loses money as a result.

C_COD_TIERS_UNCHANGED.rationale: The candidate leaves the tier percentages intact, applies the 20% standard tier correctly in an example, and clearly distinguishes the discount amount ($20) from the remainder/amount owed ($80).
